name: Rad Streams
description: Internet radio stations as TV channels: photos of each station's city, the current track and local weather, with the station playing underneath.
author: Bob

fields.label: Setup
fields.description: Enter your stations below, then press Sync Stations. Each station becomes a channel in the Rad Streams group. Channels render only while someone is watching. Validate checks every stream and city and writes a full report to /data/rad_streams/logs/validate.log.

fields.label: Stations
fields.help_text: One station per line: Name | Stream URL | City | Channel # (optional). Example: KEXP | https://kexp.streamguys1.com/kexp160.aac | Seattle, WA | 501. Use 'City, ST' or 'City, Country' when a city name is ambiguous. For photos of a subject instead of a city (no weather), put Theme: and a name in the City column, e.g. Theme: Space. Built in: Space, Earth, Nature, Ocean, Mountains, Forest, Waterfalls, Desert, Aurora, Sunsets, Beaches, Lakes, Wildlife, Night Sky; any other word is searched on Wikimedia Commons. Icecast/Shoutcast, .pls/.m3u and HLS (.m3u8) stream URLs all work. Optional extra columns: id=<old name> keeps a station's channel when you rename it, and logo=<image URL> sets its channel logo (default: the Rad Streams logo). Example: KEXP Seattle | https://kexp.streamguys1.com/kexp160.aac | Seattle, WA | 501 | id=KEXP. Lines starting with # are ignored. Press Sync Stations after editing.

fields.label: Video Bitrate (kbps)
fields.help_text: Upper limit per station. Mostly-still pictures usually use less.

fields.label: Text Movement
fields.help_text: Burn-in protection: the text moves to a new spot on every photo change.

fields.label: Photo Credits
fields.help_text: Photo and weather licences require a credit; brief shows it when each photo appears, then fades it out.

fields.label: Video Encoding
fields.help_text: A GPU takes the video encoding off the CPU. The container needs the GPU passed through (/dev/dri, or the NVIDIA runtime). Sync tests it and uses software encoding if it doesn't work.

fields.label: Server Port
fields.help_text: Local port for the channel streams (127.0.0.1 only). Change it if something else uses it.

actions.label: Sync Stations
actions.description: Create, update and remove channels to match the station list, and start the stream server.

actions.label: Validate
actions.description: Check each stream, its track titles, the city and available photos.

actions.label: Status
actions.description: Show whether the stream server is running and which stations are being watched.

actions.label: Stop Server
actions.description: Stop the stream server. Channels stay; Sync starts it again.

confirm.title: Stop Rad Streams?
confirm.message: Anyone watching a Rad Streams channel will be disconnected.

actions.label: Remove All Channels
actions.description: Stop the server and delete every channel this plugin created.

confirm.title: Remove Rad Streams channels?
confirm.message: This deletes every channel and stream in the Rad Streams group that this plugin created.
